title: How is Marilyn Monroe connected to Putin?
description: Five real photos connect Marilyn Monroe to Vladimir Putin, by way of the space race.
hook: How is Marilyn Monroe connected to Vladimir Putin?

links.line: In 1962, Marilyn Monroe sang Happy Birthday to President Kennedy, then partied with him that night.
A year earlier, Kennedy faced off with Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev in Vienna.

image.file: File:RIAN archive 159271 Nikita Khrushchev, Valentina Tereshkova, Pavel Popovich and Yury Gagarin at Lenin Mausoleum.jpg

links.line: In 1963, Khrushchev showed off Valentina Tereshkova, the first woman in space.
In 2009, Russian President Dmitry Medvedev gave her a state prize.
And Medvedev only got that job because Vladimir Putin handpicked him.
